verdict.rationale: Supabase documents official client libraries, which it uses for vector embeddings and image transformations. llms.txt publishes per-language SDK reference corpora for JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python and C#, and type generation produces typed `database.types.ts` definitions for building against the SDK. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party SDK overview listing supported languages and maturity, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
